description: Justin has been a relentless fighter against a system that rewards corporate greed, especially as Tennessee Republicans passed the largest corporate tax cut in state history, giving over $1.3 billion away to mega corporations, most of whom are located out of the state. This comes as Tennessee has one of the most regressive tax structures in the country, relying mostly on sales taxes that disproportionately tax the poor, and do nothing to stop corporate greed that is driving inflation.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Justin Jones - Treasurer Lynne Mcfarland
title: Challenging Corporate Greed - Justin Jones
